text:
kyle: Heads-up — we need to shrink the console analytics contract before Q2 dashboards rollout. current event payload has a 12kb `route_metadata` json blob that explodes query times.

sana: +1. noticed dashboard slowdowns when running route-level heatmaps.

bryan: can we materialize route tags into separate columns? that'll help group by and avoid jsonb scans.

eva: Agree. Two concerns: backfill cost and keeping writes idempotent during dual-write.

kyle: proposal: add `route_tag_set text[]` and `route_meta_hash text` columns, dual-write for 2 weeks, then backfill via controlled workers. advantage: cheap groupby and lightweight joins.

pm-chet: what's the user-visible risk? will any console graphs break during migration?

sana: graphs will read from projection if available, fallback to legacy payload. we should add a query hint layer in console that prefers projections with a feature flag.

alisha: suggest naming flag `console:use_route_projection_v1` and default false. rollout: alpha -> beta -> GA.

bryan: backfill plan sketch: small workers that scan day ranges, write to new columns, commit in batches. throttle to keep p95 ingest under 200ms.

kyle: SQL for new column creation (PG):
```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN route_tag_set text[];
ALTER TABLE analytics.events ADD COLUMN route_meta_hash text;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_route_meta_hash ON analytics.events (route_meta_hash);
```

eva: Need to ensure index build doesn't block; use CONCURRENTLY and make plan for replica promotion if needed.

infra-bot: migration-runner queued job #3742 created for schema-change dry-run on staging.

kyle: compatibility: any downstream reports or exports that parse `route_metadata` json need a compatibility shim. list them?

sana: console alerts export, billing proxy (quota calc), and a couple of old partner exports. I'll inventory and tag owners.

pm-chet: quota calc depends on `route_metadata.cost_units` — we need to populate `route_billing_units` column in the projection or keep reading json until cutover.

bryan: add `route_billing_units numeric` to projection. easier for aggregator.

alisha: UX: console should show a migration banner with expected timeline and fallback link in settings. emphasize opt-out for orgs with strict audits.

kyle: testing matrix: small prod-like dataset in staging, dual-write for 48h, compare aggregates, run fuzz tests for idempotency.

eva: also run top-queries profiling before + after to ensure we don't regress other dashboards.

bryan: one more: if projection misses values, fallback must gracefully parse json. no errors.

sana: agreed. implement a tiny helper `get_route_tags(row)` that checks `route_tag_set` then parses `route_metadata` if nil.

alisha: timeline ask: can we get schema change + feature flag ready next week for alpha?

kyle: yes — infra team to schedule migration dry-run Thurs. Sana/Bryan pair on backfill runner. Alisha to draft banner copy. PM will coordinate partner notices.

pm-chet: ok. I'll add to roadmap and ping legal for export audits.

infra-bot: migration-runner #3742 started dry-run on staging at 2026-03-20T16:02:00Z.

kyle: thanks. please post perf numbers once dry-run completes. :thumbsup:

eva: will do. if anything weird shows up I'll create a follow-up thread with query samples.

bryan: quick note — consider storing `route_meta_hash` using `sha256` of normalized tags to speed joins. avoids long text equality.

kyle: good call. include hash function in backfill runner.

alisha: copying this plan into the migration doc now and tagging owners.

kyle: cool — thread closed for now, reopen if blockers.
